text:
Ava: weekend plans! thinking of a slow Sunday: paint at the park or longboard down the waterfront. who's in?
Diego: paint sounds fun. what time?
Maya: longboard for me — perfect weather forecast :sun_with_face:
Sam: both? paint in morning, board in afternoon?
Ava: maybe. painting meetup 10am outside north park gazebo. bring a small canvas and tea.
Diego: can I borrow brushes from someone? I only have watercolors.
Maya: I have spare brushes and acrylics, @Diego. also sunscreen :sunglasses:
Sam: ETA 9:50, I'll bring a little speaker. playlist suggestions welcome.
Ava: playlist: low-fi + summer indie. link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/xyz (placeholder)
OpsBot: reminder — company picnic is on Saturday, not Sunday. Parking at Gate B closes at 9am.
Maya: oof good call @OpsBot. I'll bring folding chairs for after boarding.
Diego: +1 for chairs. and maybe snacks? I can bring empanadas.
Sam: vote: painting AM / longboard PM => react with :one:, just longboard => :two:, just painting => :three:
Maya: :one:
Diego: :three:
Ava: :one:
Sam: ok looks like painting then longboard. see y'all 10am. if anyone needs a ride DM me.
